title: Saturn Surface Gravity
body: The mean diameter of the planet Saturn is $$1.2\times10**{8}\,\text{m}$$, $$and$$ $$its$$ $$mean$$ $$mass$$ $$density$$ $$is$$ $$0.69\,\tfrac{\text{g}}{\text{cm}**3}$$ ($$690\,\tfrac{\text{kg}}{\text{m}**3}$$). Take G=$$6.674\times10**{-11}\,\tfrac{\text{N}\cdot\text{m}**2}{\text{kg}**2}$$.
